milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the agent must navigate near the sunflower (at spawn-relative [10, 0, 10]) and face it, confirming visual observation. max_distance=5 ensures the agent is close enough to clearly see it.

Uses count_in_box_at_least(kind='block', object='wheat') because planting wheat seeds on farmland creates a minecraft:wheat crop block at y=0 (one above farmland at y=-1). A generous box [5,−1,5]→[11,1,11] covers all 8 farmland positions plus padding. min_count=1 means at least one seed was successfully planted.
